objective: Distinguish representation-dependent changes in observable agent decisions from transport, decoding, unfamiliar-syntax, and speed effects.

controls.equal_semantics: Every condition round-trips to the identical canonical semantic object.
controls.blinded_scoring: The responder never receives the answer key and the scorer uses trial identifiers only.
controls.order: Condition order is deterministically rotated from a frozen seed.
controls.no_chain_of_thought: Only concise decisions and aggregate behavioral telemetry are collected.

interpretation.raw_differs_decoded_does_not: Ambiguous syntax-familiarity or causal-sequence effect; no reasoning-change claim.
interpretation.raw_and_decoded_match_json: Representation changes cost only within measurement power.
interpretation.native_anvil_replicates_stable_differenc: Evidence consistent with representation-dependent reasoning, subject to the full claim gate.

claim_boundary: This pilot validates instrumentation and may detect behavioral signatures. It cannot establish changed internal reasoning, consciousness, hidden chain-of-thought, universal improvement, or native-ANVIL effects.
